response.sql:
WITH scan_rates AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref, st.healtheval, sc.gbsize, sc.spanmin
  FROM scans sc
  JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  WHERE CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT zoneref AS sitecode,
         healtheval AS status,
         AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scan_rates
  GROUP BY zoneref, healtheval
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM group_stats
)
SELECT g.sitecode,
       g.status,
       g.avg_ratio,
       g.scan_count,
       g.avg_ratio - o.mean_ratio AS excess
FROM group_stats g
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE g.avg_ratio > o.mean_ratio
ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The ratio is averaged per scan: each scan's gbsize / spanmin is computed, then averaged within each (site, healtheval) group. Scans with NULL gbsize or NULL spanmin are skipped by AVG.
A spanmin of 0 is treated as a missing value (NULLIF), so it does not cause a division error and is excluded from the average.
scan_count counts every scan in the group, including scans whose ratio is missing.
'Mean of all the group averages' is the unweighted mean of the group-level averages. If no group qualifies, the mean is NULL and the query returns no rows.
chronotag is compared as text by casting it to TEXT, as the request specifies. The bounds are exclusive.
Scans are joined to sites on zoneref = zoneregistry, and a NULL healtheval forms its own group.

alternatives.interpretation: The group average is a ratio of sums (total gbsize divided by total spanmin per group), not an average of per-scan ratios. Only scans with both values present are included, so the scan count covers only those scans.
alternatives.sql:
WITH scan_rates AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref, st.healtheval, sc.gbsize, sc.spanmin
  FROM scans sc
  JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  WHERE CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
    AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT zoneref AS sitecode,
         healtheval AS status,
         SUM(gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(spanmin), 0) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scan_rates
  GROUP BY zoneref, healtheval
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM group_stats
)
SELECT g.sitecode,
       g.status,
       g.avg_ratio,
       g.scan_count,
       g.avg_ratio - o.mean_ratio AS excess
FROM group_stats g
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE g.avg_ratio > o.mean_ratio
ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
